name: Linear triple systems on 16 points with small independence number
description: construct() -> list of triples [a, b, c] on points 0..15 in which any two triples share at most one point. The score is the largest point set containing no triple (checked over all subsets). Minimize. A valid system with independence number a certifies f(16) <= a; no finite value is documented.
